## 站点数据提取

```{r}
st <- fread("data/Flux/st_flux341.csv") ## 这里处理了所有站点的
sp <- sf2::df2sf(st)[, 1]

process_LAI(sp, subfix = "st341", outdir = "./data")
# df_lai[site == "FI-Hyy"] %>% tail()
```

## 8day to 1day

```{r}
df_lai <- fread("data-raw/LAI/LAI_ALL_8D_2000-2024_st341.csv")
sites <- unique_sort(df_lai$site) %>% set_names(., .)
```

```{r}
# SITE <- "FI-Hyy"
period <- c(2000, 2024)
dates_daily <- seq(make_date(period[1]), make_date(period[2], 12, 31), by = "day")

res <- llply(sites, \(SITE) {
  d_lai <- df_lai[site == SITE]
  r <- d_lai[, lapply(.SD, \(x) approx_LAI(date, x, dates_daily)),
    .SDcols = c("LAI_glass_G005", "LAI_glass", "LAI_whit")
  ] %>% cbind(date = dates_daily, .)
}, .progress = "text")
saveRDS(res, "data-raw/LAI/ALL_LAI_GLASS&WHIT_1D_2000-2024_st341.rds")
# [HMo]: need at least two non-NA values to interpolate
```
